Attribution from the same-session gallery run with a G1-only build (1de77259): page_load_p50 170 -> 47 ms from revalidation removal, 47 -> 2 ms from decoding the next page ahead; gallery_open_to_first_page 749 -> 326 ms from loading the first media alone.
